events.text: Added an explicit View Only model tool (0) to the Studio action bar, Edit > Mesh Select section, and model context Select group. It routes to native selection mode 0, which hides vertex/edge/face dressing, mirror planes, and selection gizmos without changing outliner focus or destroying dormant element selections. Passed 27/27 editor command tests, test-mesh-edit, and the complete ReleaseFast editor ship build.
